xmldoc.short_description: Send an event to the page of an HTML UI component.

param_input_item.param_description: a nonempty character vector or scalar string: the name of the event.
any value that can be encoded as JSON (default: []).

description.p: sendEventToHTMLSource(h, eventName, eventData) sends a named event from Nelson to the page displayed by the uihtml component h.

In the page, the event is received by a listener registered with addEventListener(eventName, ...) on the object passed to the setup function. The data is available in the Data field of the event received by the listener.
The function returns at once: the event is queued and delivered when the page is next updated. Events are delivered in the order they were sent.
eventData travels as JSON, with the same conversions as jsonencode.

h must be a single uihtml object, otherwise the error Nelson:sendEventToHTMLSource:invalidHandle is raised. An event name that is not a nonempty text raises Nelson:sendEventToHTMLSource:invalidEventName.
Like uihtml, this function is only useful in the WebView desktop.

example_item.example_item_description: The page shows the value of each 'tick' event.
